verdict.rationale: The docs show an explicitly versioned API: the 'SendGrid v3 Web API' with versioned endpoints such as POST /v3/mail/send. Nothing in the pack documents a deprecation policy, sunset timelines, or version-lifecycle guarantees, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: a documented deprecation/sunset policy, version-lifecycle or changelog guarantees, and independent corroboration of API stability.
